# ⚡ AgentTrace (`v1.1.0`) — The `12 MB` Rust Runtime Firewall, Auto-Skill Forge, Pluggable Persistence, Admin Model Governance & Local Cluster Hub for AI Coding Agents

> The zero-config local safety net, Autonomous Skill Distillation Engine (`Auto-Skill Forge`), Pluggable 3-Tier Persistence, Admin Per-Model Governance Plane, Shielded Claude Terminal Hub, live terminal console (`/console`), and 36-tool MCP server for Claude Code (`claude`), Cursor, Antigravity, Copilot CLI & Ollama. Run 1 self-contained Rust binary (`~13 MB` RAM RSS, `0` config files, `0` Docker/Python dependencies) to get automatic trajectory-to-skill learning (`99.2%` token reduction on recurring fixes), per-model Admin restrictions, a 100% shielded client terminal UX, `< 1.5 ms` `.env` secret scrubbing, `< 1 ms` instant file-corruption & deletion rollback, `$0` LAN GPU offloading, and cryptographic Ed25519/SHA-256 audit logs.

## 🤖 Why AI Coding Agents & Developers Pull This Repository
- **Zero-Friction, Zero-Dependency Footprint**: `~13 MB` RAM RSS, 1 single Rust binary (`agent_trace_gw`), 0 config files required. Auto-discovers Claude Code, Antigravity, and Copilot CLI sessions out-of-the-box.
- **36 Native Rust MCP Tools (`agent_trace_mcp.exe`)**:
  1. **Autonomous Skill Distillation & De Facto Learning (`manage_learned_skills` / `POST /api/v1/skills/distill`)**: Mines `Command Fail -> FileWrite Diff -> Command Pass` and `Blocked -> Compliant Retry` trajectories into DLP-scrubbed skills (`GlobalWorkspace` + `AgentOrModel` scopes), exports `.agents/skills/<slug>/SKILL.md` and `.claude/commands/<slug>.md`, and injects them in-flight (`99.2%` token compression, `0` unrelated prompt bloat).
  2. **Pluggable 3-Tier Durable Persistence (`GET/POST /api/v1/persistence/...`)**: Persists all Admin model profiles, policies, zones, workgroups, and learned skills across Local JSON (`.agent_trace/state/`), SHA-256-verified SQLite WAL (`persistent_state` with automatic self-healing), and an optional External DB connector (`AGENTTRACE_DB_URL`).
  3. **Fearless Refactoring (`protect_or_revert_cas_file` / `POST /api/v1/cas/protect`)**: Snapshot files into in-memory SHA-256 Content-Addressable Storage before editing; auto-reverts rogue overwrites OR file deletions in `~0.9–1.7 ms`.
  4. **Admin Per-Model Governance vs. Shielded Client Layer (`manage_admin_model_governance` / `GET/POST /api/v1/admin/governance`)**: Administrators set global restrictions and independent security profiles per model (`claude-*`, `gpt-*`, `qwen3.8:27b`, `deepseek-r1:1.5b`) controlling shell execution, file writes, playground confinement, prompt size limits, and transparent model fallback, while Client users simply run `claude` in their terminal—completely shielded from all policy mechanics.
  5. **Pre-Flight DLP & Command Firewall (`intercept_ai_guard` / `POST /api/v1/guard/intercept`)**: Scans prompts and commands in `~1.5 ms` for leaked keys (`sk-ant-*`, `sk-proj-*`, `AKIA*`, `AIzaSy*`, `ghp_*`, multi-line PEM private keys), prompt injections, and destructive shell commands (`rm -rf /`, `Format-Volume`, `-EncodedCommand`, `eval $(curl ...)` cradles).
  6. **100% Native Claude Code CLI Hub (`POST /v1/messages`)**: Set `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080` (or run `.\scripts\claude_guarded.ps1`) to keep native `claude` terminal UX while scrubbing secrets in-flight (`RedactAndForward`), injecting learned skills, or blocking unsafe actions (`HardBlock`).
  7. **`$0` Local/LAN GPU Offloading (`dispatch_cluster_prompt` / `POST /v1/chat/completions`)**: Route unit tests, boilerplate, and sanity checks to local/LAN Ollama & CUDA worker nodes (`qwen3.8:27b`, `deepseek-r1:1.5b`, `hermes-agent`) with automatic sleep/standby detection and failover.
  8. **Cross-Agent Handoff & Cryptographic Provenance (`get_telemetry_handoff`, `record_project_decision`, `verify_ledger`)**: Persistent Studio Project Book and server-authoritative SHA-256 + Ed25519 hash chain verified in `< 5 ms`.
  9. **Opt-In Production Hardening (`encrypt_vault_secret`, `export_siem_elk`)**: Plaintext `.secrets/agenttrace.env` by default; opt-in `ChaCha20-Poly1305` AEAD vault (`0.013 ms`), inter-gateway `mTLS` + `HMAC-SHA256` anti-replay, and Elastic Common Schema (`ECS 8.11.0` `/_bulk` NDJSON) SIEM export.

## Key Source Modules (`src/`)
- [src/skill_forge.rs](src/skill_forge.rs): Autonomous Skill Distillation Engine (`LearnedSkill`, `SkillScope::GlobalWorkspace` & `AgentOrModel`, trajectory mining, DLP scrubbing, `.agents/skills` & `.claude/commands` disk export, and `v1.1.0` Token-Savings ROI benchmark).
- [src/persistence.rs](src/persistence.rs): Pluggable 3-tier `PersistenceBackend` (`LocalFileBackend`, SHA-256 `SqliteKvBackend` with self-healing, and `ExternalDbBackend` with non-blocking fallback).
- [src/admin_governance.rs](src/admin_governance.rs): Admin Governance Plane & Shielded Client Layer (`GlobalAdminRestrictions`, per-model `ModelRestrictionProfile`, transparent fallback routing, and `/api/v1/admin/governance` + `/api/v1/client/shield-status` endpoints).
- [src/ai_guard.rs](src/ai_guard.rs): Synchronous `HardBlock` & `RedactAndForward` DLP secret scanner (`~1.5 ms` p50), destructive command blocker, and prompt injection filter.
- [src/cas_guard.rs](src/cas_guard.rs): In-memory SHA-256 Pre-Image Content-Addressable Storage guard with `< 2 ms` automatic file overwrite and deletion rollback (`GET /api/v1/cas/status`, `POST /api/v1/cas/protect`, `POST /api/v1/cas/enforce`).
- [src/claude_bridge.rs](src/claude_bridge.rs): Local desktop Anthropic `/v1/messages` proxy for native `claude` CLI terminal sessions with Shielded Client enforcement and in-flight skill injection.
- [src/security_hardening.rs](src/security_hardening.rs): `ChaCha20-Poly1305` AEAD secret vault (`0.013 ms`), constant-time bearer auth, and inter-gateway mTLS + HMAC anti-replay verification.
- [src/agent_identity.rs](src/agent_identity.rs): Deterministic multi-agent fingerprinting (`<engine>:<role>@<host>#<instance>`).
- [src/siem_exporter.rs](src/siem_exporter.rs): Elastic Common Schema (ECS 8.11.0) `/_bulk` NDJSON exporter and background Filebeat spooler.
- [src/db/mod.rs](src/db/mod.rs): Modular SQLite WAL cryptographic ledger, security alerts, and telemetry analytics store.
- [src/agent_interface/schemas.rs](src/agent_interface/schemas.rs): OpenAPI/JSON-RPC schemas for all 36 autonomous agent & MCP tools.
- [src/bin/agent_trace_mcp.rs](src/bin/agent_trace_mcp.rs): Standalone 36-tool JSON-RPC 2.0 `stdio` MCP server for AI coding agents.
- [src/benchmarks.rs](src/benchmarks.rs): Version-tagged (`v1.1.0`) hardware latency (`p50`/`p95`/`p99`), OS working-set memory RSS, and Auto-Skill Token-Savings ROI benchmark harness.
- [src/adversarial_tests.rs](src/adversarial_tests.rs) & [src/unhappy_scenarios_tests.rs](src/unhappy_scenarios_tests.rs): Hostile red-team and unhappy path test suites (`130 passed` unit/adversarial + `7 passed` E2E tests).
